why: Page 4 box: state Medium saturation, drop the 'through 2027' clause, cite the 14 UK partners to S79 and the wage figure to page 5 [S3, S70].

edits.value: If I had a brand for Denmark, it would be Zambrero, in Mexican fast casual, and I would open it straight behind Taco Bell.

Fast casual is rising, and its saturation is Medium, the lowest of the three rising categories on page 3. Taco Bell is due at Fisketorvet this autumn. [S41, S78] Most readers will see a rival. I see a brand paying to teach Danes the burrito. Zambrero is not here yet: it has more than 350 restaurants in five countries and signed 14 franchise partners in the first year of its UK programme. [S79]

Avoid pizza. Domino's closed all 27 Danish stores from Jun 2023, and Pizza Hut went bankrupt in Nov 2025 with 13 restaurants. [S30, S33] The fast casual signal is still thin, so prove one site at about DKK 206 an hour all-in (Estimate, page 5) [S3, S70] before the second.
